notes: Channels with a web coped flush to the flange's inner face (both flanges cut off at the end and the web cut along the flange line) now get their toolpath. The import keeps 0.5 mm of the web standing inside the flange band so the cut along the flange is a real cut, and Import Check lists it as "Flush cope - material left" instead of the old "left as drawn" warning. The import's sliver trim no longer removes that 0.5 mm strip on such parts. Import Check's face detail now reports each face's position and tolerance.
